data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 晚宴酒杯
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 晚宴酒杯】灯红酒绿的豪华赌场露台上，身着一袭优雅露背深黑晚礼服的黑贞单手摇晃着盛满红酒的高脚杯，冷艳的眼妆在夜色下格外魅惑。她转过身将酒杯递向你——「今晚在赌桌上赢了整整一千万筹码。走吧，去把这家赌场最贵的香槟全包下来！」
data.location: 赌场外侧夜间露台的栏杆旁
data.action: 站在夜间露台栏杆边，一手将红酒杯递向同行者，另一手轻扶栏杆
data.lighting: warm terrace wall lamps with chandelier glow through the open doors
data.promptProse: Jeanne Alter turns from the casino terrace rail and offers a red-wine glass toward the viewer, her other satin-gloved hand resting lightly on the railing. A black velvet evening gown surrounds her stable, amused posture. The medium portrait places open doors and chandeliers behind her. Warm wall lamps illuminate silver hair and golden eyes, catching the wine's rim; interior chandelier glow reaches the terrace floor through the doorway.
